topic: Hand off a real task: let Claude Cowork rename a messy folder of files with one consistent pattern
post:
"final_v2_REAL_final.docx" 😅
If your folders look like this, let Claude Cowork fix the names for you.

"Rename files with consistent patterns like YYYY-MM-DD formatting" is one of the example tasks in Claude's own Cowork guide.

(YYYY-MM-DD just means a date like 2026-10-27. Files named this way sort in date order automatically.)

Step by step 👇
1️⃣ Copy the messy folder first, so you have a backup
2️⃣ Open Claude and select Cowork in the message box
3️⃣ Share ONLY that folder
4️⃣ Paste the prompt below
5️⃣ Review Claude's plan, then let it run

Copy this prompt:
"Rename every file in this folder using the pattern YYYY-MM-DD_short-description. Use the date inside each file if there is one, otherwise the date it was last changed. Show me a before-and-after list first, and don't delete anything."

The before-and-after list is the key ✅
You see every change before it happens.

📌 Cowork needs a paid plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise).

Why it matters:
Tidy file names mean less time hunting for "that one file". It's a small job that's perfect to hand off. 💡

Which folder would you clean up first? 👇
